_purpose: Sample AOI panel for the Forest Integrity Panel (forest_integrity.py). Verifies the QUANTITY half of Stora Enso's (STERV) Swedish forest mark (Bergvik Skog VAST origin, west-central Sweden).
_GEOGRAPHY_CORRECTION_20260723: CORRECTED from the prompt's 'Bergvik Skog Ost': Stora Enso holds Bergvik Skog VAST (west/central Sweden, ~83% of Bergvik assets, ~936k ha pre-deal -> consolidated ~70% of Vast + largest carve-out, ~1.15M ha productive, HQ Falun). BillerudKorsnas took OST (~350k ha, EASTERN). PRIMARY: Billerud completion release 31-May-2019 + Stora Enso restructuring release. So AOIs belong WEST-CENTRAL. Core lan for Vast: Dalarna, Varmland, Gavleborg (Gastrikland+Halsingland), Orebro (Bergslagen). The 6 boxes below sit in Dalarna/Varmland/Gavleborg-Halsingland (all correct Vast core); a v2 refinement would add an Orebro/Bergslagen box (Filipstad/Hallefors ~59.7-59.8N, 14.2-14.5E, flagged a strong Vast zone) and cross-check each box against the Skogsstyrelsen/Lantmateriet cadastral ownership layer.
_MARK_CURRENCY_NOTE: The EUR10.80/sh (~2M ha, ~EUR8.5bn) is the STALE pre-monetization mark. Stora sold 12.4% of the Swedish forest (Sep-2025) + is spinning off the rest (H1-2027); current ~EUR5.6bn on ~1.2M ha (30-Sep-2025). 31-Dec-2024 group forest FV EUR8,894m / EUR11.28/sh. This panel checks the physical estate, not the per-share arithmetic.
_sample_disclaimer: These 6 STORA_REGION boxes are a SAMPLE of an UNPUBLISHED estate. Stora Enso does not publish a parcel-level deed map (ownership is a mosaic interleaved with Sveaskog/private); v1 places boxes over CONTIGUOUS MANAGED BOREAL FOREST in the Vast core counties (lan). Read these as an estate SAMPLE, not the whole holding. Coordinates chosen over forest matrix, deliberately OFF lakes, towns and open farmland; parcel-level 'genuinely Stora' ownership is UNVERIFIABLE in v1.
_controls_note: control=protected is the METHOD VALIDATION: a national park where final-felling is legally prohibited must read ~0% clear-cut. If it reads material harvest, the METHOD is broken, not the park. control=managed_nonstora is a peer managed-forest region to check the Stora AOIs against a non-Stora baseline.
_box_size: radius_km ~4 => ~8km box (~64 km2), a few thousand 10m NDVI pixels per band window. Sized to average over stand-level noise while staying inside a single forest matrix.
_bbox_convention: [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] (EPSG:4326), same as sentinel2_buildout / crop_yield_ndvi.

aois.name: Dalarna - Orsa Finnmark managed forest
aois.rationale: Contiguous productive coniferous forest N of Orsa (Orsa Finnmark), core Bergvik Skog VAST / Stora Enso Skog Dalarna geography (Region Nord/Mora district). Chosen away from Orsasjon lake and Orsa town; matrix of managed spruce/pine on rolling terrain.

aois.name: Gavleborg - Ockelbo/Hamrangefjarden forest
aois.rationale: Managed conifer matrix W of Ockelbo in Gavleborg, historic Bergvik/Stora Enso forest-management district. Placed over forest between Ockelbo and the Halsingland border, off open Voxnan valley farmland.

aois.name: Halsingland - Ljusdal/Ramsjo forest
aois.rationale: Halsingland is prime Stora Enso Skog country. Box over the productive forest between Ljusdal and Ramsjo, N-central Halsingland, on managed conifer terrain away from Ljusnan-valley settlement.

aois.name: Varmland - Torsby/Klaralven managed forest
aois.rationale: Northern Varmland managed forest E of the Klaralven near Torsby, within the Bergvik Skog VAST Varmland footprint (Region Sydvast/Filipstad district reach). Placed on the forest plateau off the Klaralven valley farmland/settlement strip.

aois.name: Dalarna - Malung/Vasterdalalven forest
aois.rationale: Second Dalarna sample for within-county dispersion: managed conifer forest around Malung on the Vasterdalalven, SW Dalarna. Off the river valley, on the productive-forest plateau.

aois.name: Gavleborg - Bollnas/Voxnadalen forest
aois.rationale: Second Gavleborg/Halsingland sample S of Bollnas in the Voxnadalen forest, core Stora Enso Skog district. Placed on managed conifer matrix away from Bollnas town and the open Ljusnan/Voxnan confluence.

aois.name: Hamra National Park (PROTECTED - method validation)
aois.rationale: Hamra NP (established 1909, expanded 2011) is protected old-growth boreal forest and mire in NW Gavleborg where final-felling is legally PROHIBITED. This is the METHOD VALIDATION control: it MUST read ~0% clear-cut. If the panel shows material harvest here, the method is broken, not the park. radius trimmed to 3km to stay inside the park boundary and reduce spill into surrounding managed forest.

aois.name: Smaland (Kronoberg) - non-Stora managed forest peer
aois.rationale: Southern Sweden (Smaland/Kronoberg) intensively-managed private/Sodra-cooperative conifer forest, OUTSIDE Stora Enso's central-Sweden concentration. Peer managed-forest baseline: a normally-harvested Swedish forest that is NOT Stora's estate, to check whether the Stora AOIs run hotter than ordinary Swedish forestry. Smaland also sits in the granbarkborre (bark-beetle) heartland, so this control doubles as a beetle-pressure reference.
